features.title: LoRA-safe checkpoint loading for generation
features.user_visible_behavior: Generating from a LoRA-fine-tuned checkpoint actually applies the LoRA delta, instead of silently falling back to the pretrained base.
verification: python src/LDM_dp_inference.py --dp_ckpt <ckpt> --lora_ckpt <same ckpt> ... (passing the SAME file as both triggers the 'full LoRA checkpoint' load path in build_and_load_ldm)
Confirm the run log contains: [lora] full ckpt ... lora_keys=256 missing=0 unexpected=0
Cross-check: two different checkpoints must NOT produce byte-identical generated images (md5sum a shared-index sample from each).
evidence: 2026-08-10: caught the opposite (broken) case first -- LI_eps1 and LI_eps10 generated byte-identical images because --lora_ckpt was omitted, silently dropping 256 LoRA tensors via strict=False. Fixed and re-verified md5s differ.
features.notes: This is the single highest-value lesson from the 2026-08-10 session. See CLAUDE.md 'LoRA checkpoint loading pitfall'.

features.title: Two-stage metric suite runner (base pass + CLIP pass, sequential)
features.user_visible_behavior: Given a --gen_dir of generated images, produce a complete eval_summary.json (fds/tsne/fid/ssim/psnr/lpips/label + clip/clip_label/clip_diagnose) without corrupting the merge.
verification: Stage A (any free GPU): PYTHONPATH=.../src /opt/medclip_env/bin/python Eval_metric/run_feature_eval.py --paired_from_split --device cuda:<N> --metrics fds tsne fid ssim psnr lpips label ...
Wait for stage A to fully exit (grep '[ckpt_info]' in its log) BEFORE launching stage B.
Stage B (must be cuda:0): same command with --metrics clip clip_label clip_diagnose --device cuda:0
Confirm eval_summary.json has both base keys (fid, fds_symmetric, ...) and CLIP keys (clip_gap_cos, clip_label_clipzs_gap, clipdiag_signal_mean, ...) -- 104 keys total for the 2026-08-10 config.
evidence: 2026-08-10: EVAL/metric/LABEL_IMPRESSION/{eps1,eps10}/eval_summary.json, EVAL/metric/plain_eps10/eval_summary.json -- all 104 keys, both base+CLIP present.
features.notes: Running stage A and stage B concurrently on the same --out_dir races on eval_summary.json's read-merge-write; caught and killed mid-session before it corrupted output. CLIP stage must use cuda:0 -- MedCLIP appears to hardcode that device internally regardless of --device.

features.title: ablation_blocks support under LoRA (configure_lora_params / inject_lora_cross_attention)
features.user_visible_behavior: --ablation_blocks N restricts which of the 16 SpatialTransformer blocks get LoRA adapters (blocks[N-1:], same convention as the pre-existing full-DP-SGD configure_dp_params path), instead of being silently ignored under --use_lora as it was before.
verification: py_compile src/Model/lora.py src/Model/Diffusion/LDM_dp.py src/LDM_dp_finetune.py src/LDM_dp_inference.py
./init.sh -- confirm the smoke-test checkpoint (ablation_blocks=-1 in its saved args) still logs '16/16 SpatialTransformer block(s)' (regression check: old checkpoints/behavior unchanged).
Direct unit check: inject_lora_cross_attention(unet, ablation_blocks=N) for N in [-1,1,8,16,20] and confirm blocks-injected / lora-param-tensor counts match blocks[N-1:] semantics.
evidence: 2026-08-11: ablation_blocks=-1 -> 16/16 blocks, 256 lora tensors; =1 -> 16/16 (same); =8 -> 9/16, 144 tensors; =16 -> 1/16, 16 tensors; =20 -> 0/16, 0 tensors (out-of-range, degrades to empty -- configure_lora_params/configure_dp_params both raise RuntimeError on an empty param list, so this fails loudly rather than silently training nothing).

./init.sh rerun post-change: existing lr2e-3_eps10 checkpoint (ablation_blocks=-1) generated identically, log read '16/16 SpatialTransformer block(s) (ablation_blocks=-1, ...)' -- confirms backward compatibility.
features.notes: Previously --ablation_blocks was only consumed by configure_dp_params (the non-LoRA path) -- it had ZERO effect whenever --use_lora was set (true for every checkpoint trained so far, including the eval-LI-* and eval-plain-eps10 entries below). LDM_dp_inference.py's build_and_load_ldm now also reads ablation_blocks back out of a checkpoint's saved args and re-applies the same injection range at inference time, for both the adapter-only ('lora' key) and full-checkpoint-with-embedded-lora ('model' key) load paths.

features.title: Sweep ablation_blocks under the LI_eps10 config to find how many attention blocks utility actually needs
features.user_visible_behavior: Multiple LoRA checkpoints trained with the exact LI_eps10 config (EVAL/metric/LABEL_IMPRESSION/eps10/ckpt_info.json: text_mode=LABEL+IMPRESSION, target_epsilon=10, lr=2e-3, rank=4, alpha=4) but different --ablation_blocks values, each with a complete eval_summary.json, so FID/FDS/CLIP-zeroshot can be plotted against number-of-trained-blocks.
verification: training: grep '[lora] injected' <save_dir>/train.log -- ablation8 must read '9/16 SpatialTransformer block(s)', ablation16 must read '1/16'.
training: ldm_dp_final.pt / ldm_lora_final.pt exist under each save_dir once training completes.
generate+evaluate each (same 2-stage chain as eval-LI-eps10), md5-cross-check samples differ from the anchor and from each other.
compare against the ablation_blocks=-1 anchor (eval-LI-eps10 itself).
evidence: 2026-08-11/12: both runs completed cleanly. ablation16 (1 block): 4h45m, ablation8 (9 blocks): 5h53m. Both reached epsilon_spent=8.591346449555628 -- identical to the anchor to 4 decimals, confirming DP noise calibration is independent of trained-block count and this sweep isolates a single clean variable.

Result: FID/FDS monotonically favor MORE blocks (16 best: fid=2.271); CLIP zero-shot label AUROC ratio (clip_label_clipzs_ratio -- NOT accuracy, see clip-metric-terminology memory) monotonically favors FEWER blocks (1 block best: ratio=0.670 vs 16-block's 0.605) -- two reliable metric families disagree, no single ablation_blocks value dominates. Full writeup: eval_analysis/ablation_blocks_report.md, ablation_blocks_comparison.csv, ablation_blocks_dashboard.html (also published as a Claude Artifact).
features.notes: Depends on pipeline-007 (done). ablation_blocks=-1 anchor point already exists as eval-LI-eps10 -- not retrained. All other args identical to EVAL/metric/LABEL_IMPRESSION/eps10/ckpt_info.json (seed=42, target_epsilon=10.0, lr=0.002, physical_batch=4, logical_batch=256, epochs=10, lora_rank=4, lora_alpha=4.0, text_mode=LABEL+IMPRESSION). Caveat: ablation8/16's eval_summary.json carry an extra MT_DDPM_FDS field the anchor's lacks -- src/Eval_metric/fds.py gained it as a local uncommitted change between the two computations; doesn't affect any field used in the comparison.
